obligations.expected_behavior: In an isolated unproven-source fixture with all other inputs held constant, absence of the source causes the stability result to be classified as Stable ineligible.
forbidden_result: Classifying a source-absent result as Stable eligible

obligations.expected_behavior: In an isolated identity-mutation fixture with all other inputs held constant, a change in identity causes the stability result to be classified as stale.
